# New renderings chosen in iliad-054 (Iliad 9.205–306)

No departure from an Odyssey rendering. The repeated lines (9.205, 9.218, 9.221, 9.222, 9.233 and 9.264–296) take the English the packet shows; the whole units at 9.221, 9.277 (`ταῦτα μὲν αὐτίκα…`) and 9.295 repeat their published English exactly. The first line of the unit at 9.218 keeps the Odyssey 16.53 wording and the new wording only continues it.

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| κρεῖον (9.206, κρεῖον μέγα) | "a great meat-block" | "a great meat-block" (+ note: exact object uncertain, usual explanation a block or board for cutting meat) | "table", "platter", "trencher", "carving-board"; ἐλεός stays a separate word |
| ἐλεοῖσιν (9.215, εἰν ἐλεοῖσιν ἔχευε) | "in the boards" | "on the boards" (+ note: board or table for meat, exact nature uncertain) | "carving-tables" (the first draft; a departure from the Odyssey’s shipped "boards", odyssey-070, with no reason to depart), "dressers", "dishes", "platters"; kept apart from κρεῖον "meat-block" and τράπεζα "table" |
| φλὸξ ἐμαράνθη · κατὰ πῦρ ἐκάη (of a fire, 9.212) | "the flame had died away" · "the fire had burned down" | same | "was quenched", "faded"; the shipped "was burned up" is for the thigh-pieces (κατὰ μῆρ’ ἐκάη), not for a fire |
| ἁλὸς θείοιο (9.214) | "of divine salt" | "divine salt" | "holy salt", "sacred salt" (reserved for ἱερός); θεῖος "divine" as in the table |
| κρατευτάων ἐπαείρας (9.214) | "raising them on the spit-rests" | "raising them on the spit-rests" (+ note: κρατευταί are the stands on which spits rest, the usual explanation; the object and the force of the genitive are disputed, "lifting them from the rests" is the other reading) | "supports", "andirons", "stones", "forks" |
| θυηλάς (9.220) | "the offerings" | "the offerings" (+ note: portions of the food cast into the fire for the gods) | "first-fruits", "sacrificial portions", "burnt offerings" |
| σῖτον (9.216, Πάτροκλος σῖτον ἑλών) | "bread" | "bread" | "grain", "food", "corn" |
| κανέοισιν (9.217) | "baskets" | "baskets" | "trays", "panniers" |
| πλησάμενος δ’ οἴνοιο δέπας δείδεκτ’ Ἀχιλῆα (9.224, whole-line speech introduction) | "and having filled with wine a cup he pledged Achilles:" | "and, filling a cup with wine, he pledged Achilles:" (+ note: δείδεκτο is the old verb of greeting with a cup, its formation uncertain) | "greeted" (the table keeps it for δειδίσκετο without a cup), "drank to", "toasted"; follows the table’s δειδέχατ’ (4.4) "pledged" for the cup |
| χαῖρ’ Ἀχιλεῦ (9.225) | "Welcome, Achilles" | "Welcome, Achilles" | "Hail", "Greetings", "Rejoice"; follows the table’s χαίρετον (9.197) "Welcome, you two" |
| οὐκ ἐπιδευεῖς (9.225, with δαιτὸς ἐΐσης) | "we are not lacking" | "we do not go short of" | "in want of", "wanting" (avoided in the table for ἐπιδευής, 21.185, and ἐδεύετο, 16.479); follows those rows ("lacking", "went short of"); the subject "we" is supplied; δαιτὸς ἐΐσης keeps the table’s "equal feast" / "equally shared feast" |
| ἔργα μέμηλεν (9.228, δαιτὸς ἐπηράτου ἔργα μέμηλεν) | "the doings are a care" | "it is the business of … that concerns us" | "the works are on our mind", "the works are our care"; ἔργα "doings" because the word covers all the business of a feast, not a task |
| διοτρεφές (vocative, 9.229) | "Zeus-nurtured one" | "Zeus-nurtured one" | as the table’s διοτρεφές (10.266) |
| πῆμα (9.229, μέγα πῆμα) | "a very great woe" | "a very great woe" | follows the table’s πῆμα "woe" |
| ἐν δοιῇ δὲ σαωσέμεν ἢ ἀπολέσθαι νῆας (9.230) | "and in doubt it is, to be saved or to perish, the … ships" | "it is in doubt whether the … ships will be saved or will perish" (+ note: σαωσέμεν read as "to be saved", the usual explanation) | "whether to save the ships or lose them" (makes the Achaeans the subject), "in the balance", "at risk" |
| δύσεαι ἀλκήν (9.231) | "you do not put on might" | "unless you yourself put on might" | "don valour", "clothe yourself in strength", "take up courage"; ἀλκή "might" as in the table, and the garment figure of δύομαι kept |
| αὖλιν ἔθεντο (9.232) | "their camping-place have made" | "have made their camp" | "pitched their camp", "bivouacked", "made their lodging"; αὖλις "place to spend the night" |
| κηάμενοι πυρὰ πολλά (9.234) | "having lit many fires" | "having lit many fires" | "kindled", "burning many fires"; κήαι "kindle" in the middle, so "having lit" |
| ἐνδέξια σήματα φαίνων (9.236) | "showing signs on the right" | "showing them signs on the right" (+ note: right is the lucky side) | "favourable signs", "omens"; follows the table’s ἐπιδέξια "on the right" (2.353) |
| σθένεϊ βλεμεαίνων (9.237) | "greatly in his strength exulting" | "exulting greatly in his strength" | "swelling with strength", "vaunting"; follows the shipped "in his strength exulting" (8.337) |
| λύσσα · κρατερὴ λύσσα (9.239) | "frenzy" · "strong frenzy" | "frenzy" · "a strong frenzy" | "madness", "rage"; κρατερός "strong", as in the table |
| στεῦται (9.241) | "claims" | "claims" | "swears", "boasts" (reserved for εὔχομαι); follows στεῦται "claims" (3.83) |
| ἄκρα κόρυμβα (9.241) | "the topmost stern-ornaments" | "the topmost stern-ornaments" (+ note: κόρυμβα, by the old explanation, the ornamented ends of the sterns, not otherwise explained) | "peaks", "tips", "stern-posts", "crests" |
| μαλερὸν πῦρ (9.242, μαλεροῦ πυρός) | "devouring fire" | "devouring fire" (+ note: μαλερός "devouring", a traditional gloss) | "raging fire" (μαίνεται is "rages"), "ravening", "consuming" |
| ἐμπρήσειν · ἀποκόψειν · δῃώσειν (9.241–243) | "burn up" · "cut off" · "cut down" | same | "set fire to", "lop off", "slay"; δῃόω "cut down" as in the table |
| ὀρινομένους ὑπὸ καπνοῦ (9.243) | "stirred up by the smoke" | "thrown into turmoil by the smoke" | "driven by the smoke", "choked", "maddened"; ὀρίνω "stir up" |
| ταῦτ’ αἰνῶς δείδοικα κατὰ φρένα (9.244) | "These things dreadfully I fear in my mind" | "I fear these things dreadfully in my mind" | "terribly" (ἐκπάγλως); αἰνῶς "dreadfully", as in the table’s τείρω row |
| ἐρύεσθαι ὑπὸ … ὀρυμαγδοῦ (9.248) | "to draw out from under the din" | "to rescue … out from under the … din" | "to protect" (the table’s εἰρύατο "guarded" keeps that sense), "save"; ἐρύομαι "draw" in `l`, "rescue" in `i` because of ὑπό |
| ἀλλ’ ἄνα … εἰ μέμονάς γε (9.247) | "But up, if you are indeed minded" | "But up, if you are indeed minded" | "if you are eager", "if you wish"; follows the table’s ἀλλ’ ἄνα "But up" and μέμονα "be eager, be set on" |
| μῆχος · ἄκος (9.249–250, in apposition) | "remedy" · "cure" | "remedy" · "cure" | "means" (reserved for μηχανή), "device"; μῆχος keeps the table’s "remedy", ἄκος the Odyssey’s "cure" |
| κακὸν ἦμαρ (9.251) | "the evil day" | "the evil day" | "day of doom", "the day of ruin"; not the same as αἴσιμον ἦμαρ "fated day" |
| φράζευ ὅπως … ἀλεξήσεις (9.251, imperative of φράζομαι) | "plan how … you will ward off" | "plan how you will ward … off" | "consider", "ponder" (the table’s φράζεαι, 1.554, is "plan"; "ponder", "consider" avoided there); φράζομαι "plan" |
| ἀλεξήσεις (9.251) | "you will ward off" | "you will ward … off" | "defend", "keep away"; ἀλέξω "ward off" as in the table |
| ὦ πέπον (vocative, 9.252) | "O good one" | "My good fellow" | follows the table’s ὦ πέπον "O good one" / "my good fellow" (sense not known) |
| φιλοφροσύνη (9.256) | "kindliness" | "kindliness" | "friendliness", "gentleness", "affection", "courtesy" |
| ἴσχειν ἐν στήθεσσι (9.256, infinitive for imperative) | "to hold in your breast" | "you must hold … within your breast" | "check", "restrain", "keep in check"; ἴσχω "hold" |
| ληγέμεναι δ’ ἔριδος κακομηχάνου (9.257) | "to cease from evil-contriving strife" | "cease from strife that contrives evil" | follows the table’s κακομηχάνου "evil-contriving" (l), "a contriver of evil" (i for a person); ἔρις "strife" |
| λήθεαι (9.259) | "you forget" | "you forget it" | "you are forgetting", "you have forgotten" |
| ἐπέτελλ’ (active, 9.259) | "he laid his charge" | "gave his charge" | follows the table’s ἐπετέλλετο (4.301) |
| παύε’, ἔα δὲ χόλον θυμαλγέα (9.260) | "cease, and let be your heart-paining anger" | "cease, and let go the anger that pains your heart" | "leave", "give up"; θυμαλγέα keeps "heart-paining", χόλον "anger" |
| εἰ δέ … ἄκουσον (imperative after εἰ δέ, 9.262) | "But if you … listen to me" | "But if you will listen to me" | "come now", "so listen"; σὺ μέν … ἐγὼ δέ "on the one hand … on the other" in `l` |
| ὑπέσχετο δῶρ’ (9.263) | "promised" | "promised" | "undertook", "offered"; follows the table’s ὑπέσχετο "promised" |
| ἄναξ (vocative, 9.276, ἣ θέμις ἐστὶν ἄναξ) | "lord" | "lord" | "king", "master", "sire"; follows the table’s ἄναξ ἀνδρῶν "lord of men" |
| ἣ θέμις ἐστὶν ἄναξ ἤτ’ ἀνδρῶν ἤτε γυναικῶν (9.276) | "as is the custom, lord, whether of men or of women" | "as is the custom, lord, whether of men or of women" | "as is right between men and women", "the law of men and women"; θέμις "custom" as at 9.134 (published as "custom") |
| νηήσασθαι, ἑλέσθαι (infinitives for commands, 9.279, 9.281) | "to load for yourself" · "yourself to choose" | "you are to go in and load" · "you are to choose" | "load", "choose" as bare imperatives; they keep the infinitive in `l` and show the command in `i`; Agamemnon’s own imperatives νηησάσθω, ἑλέσθω stay "let him load", "let him choose" |
| ἔοις (9.284) | "you would be" | "you would be" | follows ἔοι "he would be" (9.142) |
| ἐθέλῃσθα … ἄγεσθαι (9.288) | "you wish … to lead" | "you wish to take" | "you may lead"; the infinitive is the complement of ἐθέλω here, not a command as the imperative ἀγέσθω was at 9.146 |
| ὃ δ’ αὖτ’ ἐπὶ μείλια δώσει (9.289) | "and he, in turn, besides will give dowry-gifts" | "and he in turn will add a dowry" | "and he again", "moreover"; αὖτε "in turn", μείλια "dowry-gifts" as at 9.147 |
| ἀπήχθετο κηρόθι μᾶλλον (9.300) | "was hateful in your heart the more" | "was the more hateful to you in your heart" | "became hateful" (the table’s ἀπήχθετο "was hateful"), "too hateful" (reads a comparison into μᾶλλον); κηρόθι "in the heart" |
| ἄλλους περ Παναχαιούς (9.301) | "the other Achaeans all together, at least" | "all the other Achaeans" | "Panachaeans" (an English non-word); follows the table’s Παναχαιοί "the Achaeans all together" / "all the Achaeans", περ "at least" |
| ἦ γάρ κέ σφι μάλα μέγα κῦδος ἄροιο (9.303) | "for truly among them very great glory you would win" | "for you would truly win very great glory among them" | "the glory they would give you"; κῦδος "glory", αἴρομαι "win" as at ἄροντο "won" (9.266) |
| ἕλοις (9.304, νῦν γάρ χ’ Ἕκτορ’ ἕλοις) | "you could take" | "you could take" | "capture", "kill", "overcome" (each decides what the Greek leaves open) |
| λύσσαν ἔχων ὀλοήν (9.305) | "having baneful frenzy" | "in his baneful frenzy" | "deadly", "ruinous" (reserved for οὐλόμενος); ὀλοός "baneful", as in the table |
| οὔ τινά φησιν ὁμοῖον οἷ ἔμεναι (9.305–306) | "no one, he says, like to himself is" | "none … is his like" | "equal to him", "a match for him"; ὁμοῖος "like", οἷ the reflexive dative |
